newsitem.title: USA: LPC - Four banks syndicate AMR Corp unit $1 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Four banks syndicate AMR Corp unit $1 bln loan.

text.p: NEW YORK, Feb 10 (LPC) - Four banks are syndicating a $1 billion loan for AMR Corp's American Airlines, market sources said.
The loan would support the company if employees strike, they said.
Administrative agent Citibank, syndication agents Credit Suisse First Boston Corp and Chase Manhattan Corp and documentation agent J.P. Morgan & Co Inc launched the deal last week.
The 276-day deal is priced at 37.5 basis points over the London Inter-Bank Offered Rate, with a 12.5 basis points facility fee, sources added.
The loan comes on the heels of a $1 billion credit originated by Citibank, J.P. Morgan and NationsBank Corp in December, said said.
Pricing on the previous loan is the same as the new loan, sources added.
